data.description:
### Incident Overview

tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_e2e_dedup_pass.py::test_pre_existing_dso_id_produces_zero_creates FAILS on a clean tree (confirmed via git stash on branch autofix-chunk12-20260603, SHA before 15e417d818).

#### Expected
mapping.json written by the dedup guard; zero create_issue calls.

#### Actual
AssertionError: mapping.json must be written by the dedup guard (assert False). Root cause in captured stderr: 'inbound_create: get_comments for uuid-X failed (AttributeError: FakeAcliClient object has no attribute get_comments). Skipping comment bootstrap'. The test's FakeAcliClient stub is missing a get_comments method, so the inbound_create comment-bootstrap path aborts before mapping.json is written.

#### Scope
Test-harness gap (stub incompleteness), NOT a production defect. Fix: add a get_comments stub (returning []) to FakeAcliClient in test_e2e_dedup_pass.py, or adjust the bootstrap to tolerate a missing method.

#### Discovered during
Convergence investigation for bugs 85a1/4572 (assignee shape fix). Full reconciler unit suite: 800 passed + 2 xfailed + this 1 pre-existing failure.
data.title: test_e2e_dedup_pass: FakeAcliClient lacks get_comments -> dedup-guard test fails (pre-existing)
